name: E2E-SEED-007 — 同一商品72小时内图文去重(DB端到端验证)
description: 验证同一商品在72小时去重窗口内只生产一次图文种草。通过DB查询f88_ai_process_record表验证：①seedGenerate记录去重正确 ②同item_id同processMode 72h内无重复PENDING ③retry_count>0不影响去重 ④图文与视频链路去重独立
module: 上游素材生产链路/种草链路

steps.description: [造数] 导航到商品管理页
[造数] 将女装测试商品设为F0触发种草
[造数] 验证分层修改成功
打开F88策略列表(建立页面上下文)

steps.expression: (() => { return { testType: 'db-validated-dedup', scenario: '图文72h去重', table: 'f88_ai_process_record', dedupWindowHours: 72, dedupWindowMinutes: 4320, imageProcessMode: 'seedGenerate', videoProcessMode: 'seedVideoGenerate', expectedRules: { firstEvent: '首次事件→PENDING记录落库', within72h: '72h内重复事件→filterAlreadyProcessed过滤→不新增记录', after72h: '72h后→允许再次生产', retryFilter: 'retry_count>0的记录不参与去重判断', pipelineIsolation: 'seedGenerate与seedVideoGenerate去重独立' } }; })()

steps.sql: SELECT record_id, item_id, seller_id, scene_type, biz_type, main_status, retry_count, gmt_create FROM f88_ai_process_record WHERE scene_type='generate' AND biz_type='item_material' AND is_deleted=0 AND gmt_create > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 72 HOUR) ORDER BY item_id, gmt_create DESC LIMIT 100
steps.description: 查询72h内所有图文种草记录

steps.expression: (() => { const records = ${recent72hRecords}; if (!records || !records.rows) return { ok: false, error: 'DB查询无结果' }; const rows = records.rows; const itemCount = {}; const duplicates = []; for (const r of rows) { const key = r.item_id + '_' + r.biz_type; if (!itemCount[key]) itemCount[key] = []; itemCount[key].push(r); } for (const key in itemCount) { if (itemCount[key].length > 1) { const sorted = itemCount[key].sort((a,b) => new Date(b.gmt_create) - new Date(a.gmt_create)); const first = sorted[0]; const rest = sorted.slice(1); for (const dup of rest) { const hoursDiff = (new Date(first.gmt_create) - new Date(dup.gmt_create)) / 3600000; if (hoursDiff <= 72 && dup.retry_count == 0) { duplicates.push({ item_id: dup.item_id, record_id: dup.record_id, hoursDiff: hoursDiff.toFixed(1) }); } } } } return { totalRecords: rows.length, uniqueItems: Object.keys(itemCount).length, potentialDuplicates: duplicates.length, duplicates: duplicates.slice(0, 10) }; })()
steps.description: 分析72h内同商品重复记录
72h内同商品无重复记录(去重生效)
